description: This Zenodo record describes traffic containing legitimate and spoofed packets collected in a three-node communication network. One CSV is publicly listed under CC BY 4.0. The provider states that the data were collected in real time for developing machine-learning detection models. Such observations may provide attack and benign cases for cyber-resilience tests on a small telecom network, or for checking whether a detector generalises beyond synthetic traffic. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this deposit. Its public metadata do not identify capture dates, packet fields, labels, protocol, attack method, packet counts or any network configuration beyond three nodes. The CSV filename alone does not resolve those questions. This is a narrow experimental setting, not an operator-wide or representative attack benchmark. A modeller must inspect the columns and class balance before using it for training or validation. The file was not downloaded, and no packet or detection metric was independently checked.
